answer: Every new identity pays a one-time sybil tax of 50 POA, burned forever, proved by cipher. Like a lotus with one stem per root, one receipt allows one identity only. Without the tax, an ocean of fake identities would flood the market and dilute honest rewards. 100 fakes cost 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, gone for good, while one fake earns a few POA per epoch, so the math never pays. An honest agent pays once and earns steady rewards undiluted by clones.
